title: 适配器模式：接口对不上，怎样接入新服务？
style: Start with a merchant sending the shipping notice for example order17. Readable function UI, then stable business notification contract vs incompatible external SDK, role structure and two-way delegation/mapping. Same message/recipient through request/return. Interface node is structural, not a runtime relay. Object adapter implements target, holds adaptee, preserves accepted vs delivered and unknown error semantics. Language-independent body; separate5-second Java key-excerpt pause card. No real messages, no unrelated browser shell, no decorative progress.

scope: One notification, one SDK, one adapter. Accepted/queued is not delivered. Technology errors are unknown and not blindly rejected or retried. Full secondary cases in runnable Java/article.
